A '''city''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Two [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] undertook a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Wars)|mission]] to recover a [[The Package|stolen diplomatic package]] intended for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Package" />
